key_insight: The paper argues that trustworthy data integration needs knowledge-grounded RAG systems that move from naïve retrieval to graph- and agent-based reasoning.
engineering_relevance: It is relevant for enterprise data integration pipelines because it targets more accurate, explainable, and cost-efficient decision making under limited supervision.
method: Map the progression from classic RAG to GraphRAG and KG-RAG to better bridge parametric and contextual knowledge.
Use Agentic RAG with multi-agent planning, retrieval, refinement, and reasoning for complex integration tasks.
Apply optimization strategies to reduce compute cost and improve scalability in large enterprise settings.
evidence_signal: The abstract is a vision and survey-style synthesis rather than a report of a single benchmark, so it emphasizes conceptual evolution and open challenges over measured results.
watch_item: Agentic and graph-based RAG systems may increase system complexity and operational cost if retrieval quality, planning, and grounding are not carefully controlled.
paper_title: Towards Trustworthy and Cost-Efficient Data Integration: From Naïve RAG to Agentic RAG
